claims.excerpt: Een prooidier levert na een wolvendoding bovendien voedsel aan andere dieren, van raven en coyotes tot beren en ongewervelden.
claims.claim: Animals including ravens, coyotes, bears, and invertebrates can obtain food from the remains of a wolf kill.
claims.label: F0 faithful
claims.evidence: Many other animals benefit from wolf kills. For example, when wolves kill an elk, ravens and magpies arrive almost immediately. Coyotes arrive soon after, waiting nearby until the wolves are sated. Bears will attempt to chase the wolves away, and are usually successful. Many other animals—from eagles to invertebrates—consume the remains.
claims.narrative: Laat zien dat een wolvendoding voedsel biedt aan dieren van raven en coyotes tot beren en ongewervelden.
claims.explanation: The source describes all these animals benefiting from or consuming wolf-kill remains. The wording summarizes a general pattern rather than claiming that each listed animal feeds on every kill.

claims.excerpt: Ook de samenstelling van de prooi veranderde. Onder de prooien die in de vroege winter werden gedood, verschoof tussen 1995–2000 en 2001–2007 de verhouding tussen elandkalveren en volwassen mannelijke elanden.
claims.claim: Among wolf prey in early winter, the relative proportions of elk calves and adult bull elk changed between 1995–2000 and 2001–2007.
claims.label: F0 faithful
claims.evidence: From 1995 to 2000, in early winter, elk calves comprised 50% of wolf prey, and bull elk comprised 25%. That ratio reversed from 2001 to 2007
claims.narrative: de verschuiving in de verhouding tussen elandkalveren en volwassen mannelijke elanden onder de vroege-winterprooien in 1995–2000 en 2001–2007
claims.explanation: The source explicitly reports the early-winter proportions and says the ratio reversed in the later period. “Verschoof” does not overstate the direction or size of the change.
claims.materiality: Accurately reports the periods and prey categories.

claims.narrative: de bron verbindt die veranderingen met de beschikbaarheid en kwetsbaarheid van prooien.
claims.explanation: The source says the ratio change indicates changes in vulnerability and availability; the piece attributes the association to the source rather than asserting a single cause.

claims.claim: Changes in wolf predation and effects on elk occur in interaction with other factors, including other predators, ungulate management outside the park, and weather.
claims.label: F0 faithful
claims.evidence: Changes in wolf predation patterns and impacts on prey species like elk are inextricably linked to other factors, such as other predators, management of ungulates outside the park, and weather (e.g. drought, winter severity).

claims.explanation: The source explicitly links predation patterns and elk impacts to the listed factors. “Vallen samen” is no stronger than the source’s description of complex interactions.
